code: import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}dealer-bank`;const getDealerBanks=async params=>{const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL,{params:{...params,limit:+(params===null||params===void 0?void 0:params.limit)||50}});return response.data;};const getDealerBanksByStatus=async status=>{const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL+'/'+status);return response.data;};const deleteDealerBank=async id=>{const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+"/"+id);return response.data;};const updateDealerBank=async(id,data)=>{const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+"/"+id,data);return response.data;};const createDealerBank=async data=>{const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,data);return response.data;};const dealerBankService={createDealerBank,getDealerBanks,deleteDealerBank,updateDealerBank,getDealerBanksByStatus};export default dealerBankService;
